For white, forward squares are larger row numbers; for black, forward squares are smaller row numbers. Knight moves: L-shaped: two squares in one direction then one perpendicular; like (dx, dy) combos: (2,1) or (1,2) in both directions. However only forward moves are allowed: i.e., the destination must be forward relative to the moving piece.

Also can capture opponent pieces: if the destination cell contains an opponent piece, you capture and remove it. The piece moves onto that square, presumably (no "jump over" pieces other than the knight's move pattern). So we can capture opponent pieces.

```
            if dest in board:
                if board[dest] == role:
                    continue  # own piece
                # capture opponent piece
            # move allowed
            moves.append((col, row, new_col, new_row))
    return moves
```
